2760-4279-7192.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2760-4279-7192.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Grave Venerations triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2760-4279-7192.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

17-1770-2226.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
17-1770-2226.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Elesh Norn.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Lava Zombie by paying its mana cost.
When Lava Zombie enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2511-7173.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2511-7173.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

4365-5478-6441-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
4365-5478-6441-6753-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2665-7936.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2665-7936.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Dominion Saboteur and Progenitor Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dominion Saboteur trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2665-7936.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

533-4094-7839.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature or artifact.
Your commander is on the battlefield.
533-4094-7839.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Makeshift Munitions by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens due to Kaya, Geist Hunter.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-6596-7542.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control two untapped creatures excluding the mana-producing creature and Harmonized Trio.
1636-6596-7542.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Harmonized Trio by tapping it and two other creatures you control, causing it to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Brainstorm by paying {U}.
Hermes triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

5223-5477-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
5223-5477-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
5223-5477-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

567-6996-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-6996-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

483-2469-5220-6900.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

4613-4968-7451.description:
Activate Blech by using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Blech triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

757-5904-7014.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2049-2079-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2049-2079-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ogre Chitterlord as attackers.
Ogre Chitterlord triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

507-6614.description:
Whenever a player casts a spell from their hand, Possibility Storm triggers, exiling the spell and allowing the player to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a spell that shares a type with the exiled spell, and cast it without paying its mana cost.
If the player chooses to cast the spell, Vexing Bauble triggers, countering that spell since no colored mana was spent to cast it.

225-539-2908-3147.description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}
Cast Dream Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When Dream Stalker enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Dream Stalker trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Repeat.

4195-4574-4708-5741.description:
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Dark Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Dark Sphere from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

997-1778-5220-6900.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

2760-3108-5241.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Sakashima's Student.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Sakashima's Student by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

270-1987-4423-6650.easyPrerequisites:
The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
You control three additional Islands.
270-1987-4423-6650.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Hedron Archive by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Hedron Archive.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

522-2111-5226.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

1545-4186-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1545-4186-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-5078-6747-6769.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two counters on creatures you control.
3532-5078-6747-6769.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Surge Conductor triggers, putting a counter on a creature you control that already has a counter on it.
Repeat.

632-2034-3480-3621-5129.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-2034-3480-3621-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

1495-2161-4613.description:
Activate Scion of the Swarm by using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Scion of the Swarm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

527-542-1753.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
527-542-1753.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

678-5670-5789.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using one colored mana with the mana to cast it.
678-5670-5789.description:
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1563-1753-2457-3129.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

851-1563-1849-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2060-2577-6431.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3967-4871-5695-6019.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Infested Thrinax and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Infested Thrinax trigger, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni abilities from steps 3 and 7.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

3698-4321-5777.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
3698-4321-5777.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
When the Food enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

3769-4691-5919.notablePrerequisites: Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3769-4691-5919.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Blim.
Blim triggers, giving control of Vilis to an opponent.
During that opponent's draw step, they draw a card.
Razorkin Needlehead triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 4 until the opponent loses the game either due to drawing from an empty library, or from having 0 life.

3259-4885-5734.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control other than Death Tyrant.
3259-4885-5734.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any creature you control except Death Tyrant, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Death Tyrant triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat each combat phase.

2051-2546-3178-4067.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
2051-2546-3178-4067.description:
Activate Forgotten Cave's cycling ability by paying {R} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Forgotten Cave ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a land card.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Mind over Matter ability, untapping target artifact, creature or land.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate the three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}{G}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Forgotten Cave and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3079-3615-4050-4999.manaNeeded: {1} if you have discarded and/or cycled exactly two cards
3079-3615-4050-4999.notablePrerequisites: You have discarded and/or cycled at least two cards this turn.
3079-3615-4050-4999.description:
Cast Hollow One from your graveyard by paying at most {1}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hollow One, adding one mana of any color.
Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Humility removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.
If you have discarded and/or cycled three or more cards, this combo nets infinite colored mana.

2232-2368-3475-4608-5220.notablePrerequisites:
The World Spell has exactly two lore counters on it.
You control five or more enchantments.
2232-2368-3475-4608-5220.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The World Spell triggers, putting a lore counter on itself.
The World Spell's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to put Tom Bombadil onto the battlefield from your hand and sacrifice The World Spell.
Mortuary, Cloudstone Curio and Tom Bombadil each trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting The World Spell on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Tom Bombadil trigger, causing you to reveal The World Spell from the top of your library and put it onto the battlefield.
Choose to have The World Spell enter with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Cloudstone Curio and The World Spell's third chapter ability trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Tom Bombadil to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the World Spell trigger, causing you to put Tom Bombadil onto the battlefield from your hand and sacrifice The World Spell.
Repeat from step 3.
If desired, you may return a creature card to your hand in step 5, which can then be returned in step 2 for infinite blinking of any creature(s).

2103-2556-2963.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

2713-4687-4949.notablePrerequisites: Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
2713-4687-4949.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn by tapping it, adding {G/U} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

261-476-539-1491-4495.notablePrerequisites:
Sinking Feeling and New Horizons attached to Questing Phelddagrif.
Questing Phelddagrif does not have summoning sickness.
261-476-539-1491-4495.description:
Activate Questing Phelddagrif by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Questing Phelddagrif's first ability by paying {G}, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn and causing an opponent to create a 1/1 Hippo creature token.
The Hippo enters the battlefield, triggering Suture Priest's second ability, causing the opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Questing Phelddagrif by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

2634-3309-4276.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U}{U}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2634-3309-4276.notablePrerequisites: Artifacts you control can tap to produce at least {4}.
2634-3309-4276.description:
Activate all mana-producing artifacts you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Cast Rootha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{U}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Turnabout.
Activate Twinning Glass by paying {1} and tapping it, casting Rootha without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Turnabout, untapping all artifacts you control.
Activate all mana-producing artifacts you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Repeat from step 4.

2103-2556-4305.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Mnemonic Wall.
2103-2556-4305.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
